wholePhysicalScope: Native mapped stadium, playing field and west press box and the exact surrounding USGS bare-earth survey. The completed seating colors, shadow lines, access aisles and scoreboard proportions follow the two current photographer-dedicated views.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the historic arcade, sunken bowl, turf, elevated press box and scoreboard forms.
limitations: Stadium, field and press box use the measured map and LiDAR. Row exactness, small concessions and rail profiles are representative.
Team logos, temporary event signage and adjacent athletic-center interiors are outside the model.
